description: SIFT1M: one million 128-dimensional SIFT descriptors with 10 000 queries and their exact 100 nearest neighbours under L2, as repackaged by ANN-Benchmarks. This is the corpus ADR-0035 used when it measured the ~25x QPS gap against the ScaNN library, so it is the only corpus on which a measurement against the scann access method can be compared to that conclusion.

license.name: unverified - TEXMEX/INRIA corpus repackaged by ANN-Benchmarks

preprocess.description: None. The HDF5 is read as published; published distances are never read, and recall is recomputed from the vectors.
